parsedOutput.description: A comforting, one-pan meal featuring tender chicken and sweet glazed carrots nestled in fluffy rice. This hearty dish is perfect for a cozy weeknight meal that feels like a warm hug.

instructions.body: Season the chicken thighs generously with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet or pot, heat olive oil over medium-high heat and sear chicken skin-side down until golden, then remove chicken.
Add the diced onion and sliced carrots to the pan, sautéing for 5 minutes until slightly softened.
Stir in the rice and chicken broth, scraping the bottom of the pan to release any flavor.
Place the chicken thighs back on top of the rice mixture, cover tightly, and simmer for 25 minutes until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through.

parsedOutput.description: A comforting and zesty meal that combines tender shredded chicken with creamy beans and a bright salsa kick. It is the perfect quick solution for a busy weeknight when you need something satisfying without the heavy lifting.

instructions.body: In a large skillet over medium heat, combine the shredded chicken, drained black beans, and salsa.
Cook for about 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the mixture is heated through and well combined.
Lay the tortillas flat and spoon a generous amount of the chicken and bean mixture into the center of each.
Roll the tortillas tightly and place them seam-side down in the skillet for 1 minute per side to lightly crisp them.
Serve warm, topped with a sprinkle of cheese and fresh cilantro if desired.

Divide into bowls and drizzle with maple syrup before serving.

parsedOutput.description: A comforting blend of tart frozen berries tucked under a crunchy, golden oat topping. This warm dessert is perfect for cozy weekend evenings.

instructions.body: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C) and lightly grease an 8x8 inch baking dish.
Spread the frozen mixed berries evenly across the bottom of the prepared dish.
In a medium bowl, combine the oats, flour, brown sugar, and cinnamon.

Sprinkle the crumble topping evenly over the berries.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the fruit is bubbling and the topping is golden brown.
